_readme: Colour code: [[c:...]] CYAN = not confirmed yet (a best guess or a new idea from Claude, for the owner to approve). Plain text = confirmed by the owner.
name: Old Bakehouse

layers.essential_history: [[c:This private home gets its name from an old bakehouse. We'd love to add a proper fact here once we've asked around the village.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:The name suggests this house was once the village bakehouse, where bread was baked in a big oven for the neighbours. That's our best guess, and we still need to find out when it stopped baking.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:Journal page: bread and grain pass through every kitchen on the estate, and somebody has been counting the sacks very carefully.]]

puzzle_note: [[c:No puzzle here. Just enjoy the view.]]
directions_to_next: [[c:Head north-west for about 60 metres to Glebe Stores. It is the village shop, close to the Bakehouse. Keep to the pavements and paths, and look from the road only.]]
private_note: This is a private home, so please look from the road only.
